description: Erection of a single storey side with part first floor side extension and single storey rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Existing GA, Existing Elev, Proposed GA, Proposed Elev, Proposed Site Plan/Location Plan and Fire Safety Statement. Received on 16/12/2022].
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the side elevation at ground floor level and the front elevation at first floot level shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.

Condition : 6 - The extensions and accommodation hereby approved shall be used solely as part of the house known as 52 Craigwell Avenue and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor as a house in multiple occupation, including any use within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it.
